'''Shiagi Hold''' is an [[Aiel]] [[hold|settlement]] in the [[Aiel Waste|Three-fold Land]]. It is clan hold to the [[Nakai]]. [[Bruan]], a [[clan chief]], and [[Alsera]], a [[Wise One]], are from this hold. Alsera told [[Seana]] in a dream that Bruan was coming from Shiagi Hold to [[Alcair Dal]] as fast as possible after [[Rand al'Thor]] went to [[Rhuidean]].{{ref/book|4|49}}
